full_corpus_scan_measurement: After TUH DUA + PhysioNet downloads, walk one file per corpus and fill presence from actual headers/sidecars. That replaces this inventory.
source_note: Presence codes from published specs, not a byte scan of the corpora. always / often / rare / never.

sources.BIDS-EEG: BIDS EEG specification (Pernet et al. 2019). eeg.json, channels.tsv, electrodes.tsv, events.tsv, participants.tsv.
sources.CHB-MIT: PhysioNet chbmit (Shoeb 2009). EDF, 256 Hz, bipolar 10-20, seizure annotations in per-subject summary text.
sources.Sleep-EDF: PhysioNet sleep-edfx (Kemp et al.). EDF + hypnogram EDF, 100 Hz EEG, Fpz-Cz / Pz-Oz, stages W/1/2/3/4/R.
sources.TUAR: TUH EEG Artifact Corpus v3.0.1 documentation. Same EDF+ container as TUEG; labels EYEM, CHEW, SHIV, ELPP, MUSC.
sources.TUH_EEG: Obeid & Picone 2016 PMC4865520; TUH electrodes_and_channels technical report; TUEG overview (EDF+, 250 Hz typical, 24-36 ch, AR/LE TCP montages).
